title: Mockshop script
description: An executable script YAML/JSON file: optional reusable world/content and profile, then ordered scenes with stable IDs or a precise flat manual step list. References and structured use defaults resolve before validation and plugin compilation.

name.description: Output folder / clip name. Default: the file name without .yaml.

title.description: Informational label (not read by the runner).

world.description: World YAML/JSON path, relative to this script.

content.description: Script-local additions and overrides, with the world shape; validated after composition.

remove.description: Entity paths removed after composition and before reference validation.

profile.description: One reusable presentation profile path, relative to this script; --profile replaces it.

scenes.description: Ordered scenes, each with stable scene and step IDs. Cannot be combined with root steps.

viewport.description: [width, height]. Default: manifest runner.viewport, else [1440, 900]. clip.viewport wins in clip mode.

theme.description: prefers-color-scheme (default light). An explicit theme here, in presentation, a profile or --render-overrides is also sent to the mock as core.state.theme for plugins to apply; without one the world's own preference stays.

locale.description: Language for this script. Precedence: CLI --locale, script locale, manifest runner.locale, a selector cookie in cookies, then manifest localization.default (else en-US). Must be in localization.locales when the plugin lists them.

timezone.description: IANA zone. Default: manifest runner.timezone, else America/New_York.

cookies.description: Extra cookies added after the manifest's runner.cookies.

overlays.description: Extra fixture layer dirs under the plugin's fixtures/ (e.g. demo-empty-sidebar).

demo_anchor.description: Fixed demo 'now' (ISO 8601 with offset). Default: manifest runner.demo_anchor, else the real start time.

continue_on_error.description: Keep running after a failed step. Default false.

strict.description: Fail on any problem (console errors, HTTP>=400, unmocked requests), not just failed steps. Default: manifest runner.strict, else false.

requires.description: Edition name(s) the built runtime must have; otherwise shot/clip skip this script.

id.description: Stable author-chosen name, unique within its script.

presentation.description: Render settings. Cursor toggles retain inherited appearance; narrower scopes revert when they end.

scopedPresentation.description: Temporary cursor and clip pacing settings. Frame/session/encoding options are script-wide.

knownErrors.description: Strict-mode allowlist: runner problems matching an entry are reported as known (with the reason) and do not fail the run. Failed steps are never allowlisted. Added to manifest runner.known_errors.

match.description: Substring of the problem line, or /regex/flags.

reason.description: Why this is expected (upstream race, declared placeholder, ...). Reviewed by the plugin owner.

cursor.description: Cursor options (docs/cursor.md): a known style name, true/false, or an object with motion/look options and optional shot still keys.

cursorLook.description: Built-in shape or custom SVG path (which overrides shape). Null fallback values retain the existing renderer defaults.

clip.description: Clip-mode pacing (all optional). Defaults from core/clip.mjs clipDefaults().

type_delay_ms.description: Default 55; per keystroke when type_ms is null.

type_ms.description: Default 2500; fixed total time per `type` step, used only when type_cps is null; null = per-keystroke.

type_cps.description: Default 32; typing speed in characters per second. A `type` step without clip_ms takes length / type_cps seconds, clamped to 700..3200 ms. null = fixed type_ms.

nav_fade.description: Default 450 ms crossfade between navigations; 0 = hard cut.

fade_ms.description: Default 450; crossfade for click steps with fade: true.

title.description: Title card over the first page: a string or { title, subtitle }.

cursor.description: Default true: draw the cursor overlay.

locatorObject.description: Exactly one base key; the runner checks them in this order: testid, role, placeholder, label, selector, text.

exact.description: Exact match for name (with role) or text.

selector.description: CSS/Playwright selector; visibility is NOT filtered.

delay.description: type, shot mode: ms per key (default 15).

clip_delay.description: type, clip mode: ms per key.

clip_ms.description: type, clip mode: total typing time (default: length / clip.type_cps, clamped 700..3200 ms); null = per-keystroke.

click.description: type, clip mode: click the field first (cursor glide, hover, press) unless the pointer is already on it. Default true; false focuses without a click.

cursor_path.description: type: ordered cursor waypoints ([x, y] CSS px or locator) moved through while this one step types; the step ends when both finish. Clip: glides; shot: the pointer ends at the last waypoint.

edge.description: scroll: move the located element's own native scroller (itself, else its nearest scrollable ancestor, else its frame's document) to this edge instead of scrolling the element into view.

fade.description: click, clip mode: crossfade the state change.

cursor.description: Inline per-step cursor override; a step-level cursor modifier takes precedence.

hold.description: Clip mode ms to hold after moving.

scrollBy.description: Pointer-anchored wheel scroll: glide the pointer to `at`, then wheel `by` px.

at.description: Where the pointer goes before the wheel (clip: glides there). Default: the centre of the main content area, never the sidebar.

click.description: The visible control (e.g. Add Files) whose click opens the native file chooser.

name.description: File name shown to the app. Default for `path`: its base name.

text.description: Inline UTF-8 content, uploaded as an in-memory file.

path.description: File read relative to this script's folder.

metaObject.description: Free-form author data (for example lint allowances or QA intent). Never an operation; copied into the clip timeline's action record.

step.description: Exactly one operation, plus an optional stable ID, presentation, and precise only/at/cursor modifiers.

beats.description: DOM replay: which phases of this turn become presenter beats (default both).

send.description: Plugin convenience: exact authored question and response, with an optional completion wait. The selected plugin must compile it.

only.description: Run this step only in clip mode or only in screenshot mode.

at.description: Clip mode: wait until this clip timestamp before running the step. Seconds (12.5), '12.5s', '1500ms' or 'mm:ss.s'.

cursor.description: Per-step cursor override for this step (docs/cursor.md).

goto.description: Path appended to the base URL, e.g. /app. Query strings are fine.

click.description: Click at the element centre. Locator (+ fade, settle for clips).

move.description: Glide the cursor to [x, y], a locator, or {to, hold?, cursor?} without clicking.

pause.description: ms; clip mode only (no-op for screenshots).

card.description: Full-screen title card; clip mode only.

fill.description: Locator + value; sets the value instantly.

type.description: Locator + value; keystrokes (+ delay, clip_delay, clip_ms, click, cursor_path). Clip mode clicks the field first unless click: false.

press.description: Playwright key name, e.g. Enter, Control+K.

wait.description: ms, or a locator (+ state: attached|detached|visible|hidden, timeout ms, default 20000).

wait_gone.description: Wait until the locator is hidden (+ timeout ms, default 20000).

settle.description: Wait for network idle and no skeletons, then ms (default 600).

assert_state.description: Assert against the mock backend's own state (runner-only state API), not the page. Operators: equals, not_equals, in, contains, exists, count, keys, unchanged_since (+ except), equals_snapshot.

snapshot_state.description: Remember an entity or list of the mock backend's state under a name (as:) for a later assert_state unchanged_since / equals_snapshot. Replaces sessionStorage threading.

scroll.description: Pixels to scroll down (negative = up), {by, at} for a pointer-anchored wheel, or a locator to scroll into view (+ edge: top|bottom to move that element's own scroller to an edge).

upload.description: Click the visible control that opens a file chooser, then set the files (text: in-memory, path: relative to the script).

mark.description: Named timeline marker (no browser action). Written to the clip timeline and, with --dom, a presenter beat.

world.description: Advanced persistent whole-world switch (for account/org-switch demos), compiled to a complete fixture set. No scoped entity mutations.

viewer.description: Switches who is signed in to another shared person (world `people` key), compiled like a world switch with the same world. Follow with goto.

state.description: Persistent explicit app screen state, or an exact manual fixture overlay switch. Plugin entity keys are compiled to backend values; the current conversation is retained unless resetChats is explicit.

oneOf.description: A step with cursor and optional modifiers: change manual cursor settings from here on (no browser action).

field.description: Dotted path into the entity (or the column of each list row).

where.description: List filter: every field equals its value.

order_by.description: List order: a field, '-field' for descending.

keys.description: List only: entity keys in order.

beat.description: DOM replay: also make this shot a presenter beat (default false; beats come from mark steps and send phases).

delay.description: Shot mode ms before capture. Default 300.

hold.description: Clip mode ms the beat holds. Default clip.hold_ms.

mouse.description: Park the mouse here (default: bottom-right corner).

cursor.description: Inline cursor override for this shot; a step-level cursor modifier takes precedence.
